business_problem: BNY wanted to scale generative AI across a systemically important financial institution without treating it as a side experiment, so it needed a governed way for employees to build agents, use frontier models, and access sensitive workflows while preserving trust, oversight, and policy controls.
solution_summary: BNY built a centralized AI operating model around its AI Hub and Eliza, an internal AI deployment and education platform where prompting, agent development, model selection, sharing, permissions, and oversight happen inside one governed environment. Employees complete mandatory training before receiving access, then build agents against approved OpenAI capabilities under review from a data use review board, an AI release board, and the Enterprise AI Council. Eliza first supported private agent creation, then expanded to controlled sharing and advanced "digital employees" that can handle tasks such as payment instruction validation and code security enhancement. A select group also uses ChatGPT Enterprise with deep research to reason across internal and external data for legal analysis, risk modeling, scenario planning, and client preparation, with an orchestrator layer designed to connect outputs into downstream client workflows.

solution_components.name: Eliza
solution_components.role: Serves as BNY's internal platform where employees prompt models, build agents, select tools, and share approved workflows inside a governed environment.

solution_components.name: ChatGPT Enterprise
solution_components.role: Gives select teams secure access to OpenAI capabilities for higher-stakes legal, risk, and client-preparation work.

solution_components.name: deep research
solution_components.role: Runs multi-step reasoning across internal and external data to support novel legal questions, scenario planning, and strategic analysis.

data_flow: Employees complete responsible-AI training, then use Eliza to prompt models, build agents, and share approved workflows under embedded permissions and oversight. For higher-complexity work, select users invoke ChatGPT Enterprise and deep research across internal and external data, and Eliza's orchestrator layer can pass those outputs into downstream client and operational workflows while governance boards review high-impact cases.
business_outcome: BNY turned generative AI into a governed enterprise platform with more than 125 live use cases, 20,000 employees actively building agents, faster legal review, and training coverage across nearly the entire workforce while keeping permissions, telemetry, and policy oversight embedded in the system.
